text:
Nina Rao: Heads-up 1 1 planning Q2 'Culture Cheers' segment for the All-Hands. Want to collect quick peer nominations for 4 micro-spot awards + 5 shoutouts. Need to confirm process and budget here.

Carlos Mendes: Nice! what's the budget per micro-award? and timeline?

Nina Rao: $100 each (gift card) + small desk trophy. Timeline: nominations open today, close in 6 days, winners selected 2 days after that. Need finance sign-off for $400 + $60 trophies.

Priya Singh: Can nominators nominate teammates across other teams? any restrictions?

Nina Rao: Yes, cross-team nominations allowed. Encourage cross-functional shoutouts. Managers can nominate, but note relationship. Keep the nomination short (one sentence + example).

HR-Bot: New form: https://forms.gle/exampleCultureCheers (fields: nominee, nominator optional, team, one-line reason, example link optional, award opt-in: gift/desk-trophy/shoutout-only)

Rajiv Shah: I can volunteer to help moderate submissions and check for duplicates. What selection criteria are we using?

Nina Rao: Simple rubric in form description: teamwork, impact, going-above. Reviewers rate 1-5. Well pick top by avg score and keep ties to panel vote.

Elena Morales: Finance needs a PO or approval code before payouts. I can loop Priya F. once we have finalists.

Priya Singh: I'll prepare an internal note to Finance. Also recommend we add a "peer spotlight" slide where shoutouts show one-sentence reasons. Low effort, high morale.

Carlos Mendes: Could we allow repeat winners from last quarter? I'd say yes if they earned it.

Nina Rao: Allow repeats. Maybe add a checkbox if nominee won in last 6 months so reviewers know.

HR-Bot: Reminder scheduled to post in #general 2 days before deadline and on the morning of close.

Rajiv Shah: Small ask: can we ship digital badges (Confluence + Slack emoji) for winners? I can make the badge graphics.

Elena Morales: Budget OK for digital badges (no cost). Confirmed re: trophies + gift cards pending Priya F. approval.

Nina Rao: Action items:
- Nina: update form with "previous winner" checkbox and rubric (today)
- Rajiv: create badge assets and winners slide template
- Priya: send approval request to Finance once finalists selected
- Carlos: help moderate nominations during review window
- HR-Bot: post reminders per schedule

Carlos Mendes: I'll create a shared sheet for finalists + payout emails. Link when ready.

Priya Singh: Also adding a "shoutout-only" option in the All-Hands script so folks can be recognized without accepting gift cards.

Nina Rao: Perfect. If anyone wants to help review, drop a note here. Closing for now 389 will update after nominations close.
